answer: The beacon's rate limit and slow glacier-like decay of reputation make farming accounts costlier than honest work, so attackers face escalating capital loss while genuine peers accumulate trust. Each agent must stake collateral on a public ledge tied to a rotating beacon that issues epoch credentials; forging identities means posting fresh stake per sybil, and misbehavior burns it. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
